entityTax: Commerce Tax (gross receipts over $4 million) and Modified Business Tax on payroll; no corporate income tax

entityTaxDetail.summary: Commerce Tax on Nevada gross revenue above $4 million; the rate depends on the industry; the return is due 45 days after the June 30 fiscal year end (August 14)

permitFee.note: Sales tax permit fee for each in-state business location; adding or updating a location also costs $15.

penalty.note: 2% of the tax for 1 to 10 days late, 4% for 11 to 15, 6% for 16 to 20, 8% for 21 to 30 and 10% for 31 or more days (NAC 360.395).

unemployment.note: $5 for a report even one day late, plus 0.1% of taxable wages for each month or part of a month beyond the first 10 days.

newHire.note: No current official penalty amount for a late new hire report was found; secondary sources conflict or give only the federal $25 and $500 ceilings.

laborPosters.note: Administrative penalty of up to $5,000 per violation for required wage and labor postings (NRS 608.195).

workersComp.note: Administrative fine of up to $15,000, premium penalties and possible closure for an uninsured employer (NRS 616D.200).

penalty.note: Late state business-license renewal penalty, in addition to the annual license fee.
